items.q: How does the checker find problems?
items.a: It scans your ad text for words and phrases that commonly cause rejections under Meta's Advertising Standards and suggests safer wording.

items.q: Why was my ad rejected even though the checker found nothing?
items.a: Meta also reviews images, videos, landing pages and your account history. Check each of them against the policy and request a review if you think it was a mistake.

items.q: Is the Meta ad policy checker free?
items.a: Yes. The Meta ad policy checker is free to use as often as you like, with no sign-up or login.
No. It runs inside your browser, so what you type stays on your device and is not sent to us.

items.q: Can you handle Meta ads, including policy issues?
items.a: Yes. Our performance marketing team builds Meta campaigns in your own ad account and handles rejections.
